root_cause.text: In the amdgpu GMC NPS memory-range path, amdgpu_gmc_get_nps_memranges() freed the ranges buffer with kfree() even though amdgpu_discovery_get_nps_info() allocated it with kvcalloc(), creating an allocator/deallocator mismatch when kvcalloc() returned vmalloc-backed memory.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states that “amdgpu_discovery_get_nps_info() internally allocates memory for ranges using kvcalloc(), which may use vmalloc() for large allocation” and that “Using kfree() to release vmalloc memory will lead to a memory corruption,” and the patch changes `kfree(ranges);` to `kvfree(ranges);` in `amdgpu_gmc_get_nps_memranges()`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Use kvfree() instead of kfree() when releasing ranges so the function safely frees memory regardless of the allocator used.
intent_record.what: The cleanup call in amdgpu_gmc_get_nps_memranges() was changed from kfree(ranges) to kvfree(ranges) in the err: path.
intent_record.how: This makes deallocation safe for memory that may have been allocated by either kmalloc-style or vmalloc-style allocators, preventing incorrect freeing behavior and potential runtime memory management issues on the error/exit path.

grouping_result.intent: Use kvfree() instead of kfree() when releasing ranges so the function safely frees memory regardless of the allocator used.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly fixes the allocator/deallocator mismatch in amdgpu_gmc_get_nps_memranges() by replacing kfree() with kvfree() for memory allocated via kvcalloc(), which is the stated root cause.

candidates.rationale: This frees the ranges buffer with kfree() even though the buffer may have been allocated by kvcalloc(), which can return vmalloc-backed memory requiring kvfree(). The allocator/deallocator mismatch is the direct root cause.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement frees the ranges buffer with kfree() even though the buffer can be allocated by kvcalloc() in the NPS memory-range path. If kvcalloc() returned vmalloc-backed memory, using kfree() causes an allocator/deallocator mismatch, which is the root cause of the vulnerability.

bic_trace_step.reason: The function body is sufficient to determine the issue. It obtains `ranges` from `amdgpu_discovery_get_nps_info(adev, &nps_type, &ranges, &range_cnt);` and later frees that buffer at the common exit path with `kfree(ranges);`. Per the stated root cause, `amdgpu_discovery_get_nps_info()` allocates this buffer with `kvcalloc()`. Using `kfree()` on memory that may be vmalloc-backed from `kvcalloc()` is the allocator/deallocator mismatch that constitutes the vulnerability. The fix would require `kvfree(ranges);`, but this code uses `kfree(ranges);`, so the vulnerable construct is present and the fix is not.
